turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling, this is Priya. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, I was charged twice for my monthly plan and I need that fixed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. Can I get the account number or the email on the account?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. I can see two charges of $45.00 on October 3rd. The second one is a duplicate.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Right, that's what I saw. Can you reverse it?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I've submitted a refund for $45.00. It should show up in 3 to 5 business days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help with?
